caption: The drawing depicts a single, elongated, triangular wooden object positioned horizontally on a plain, light-colored background. This object has a slightly weathered appearance, with visible wood grain and some small cracks and holes. It features an intricate decorative design along its top surface: a raised, curling vine or tendril pattern, painted in shades of blue-green with detailed leaf shapes. At the narrower end of the wood, there is an ornately carved element resembling a stylized animal or bird’s head, with a beak that is open and colored yellow, green, and brown, with a hint of red inside the open mouth. The object is rendered with fine lines and realistic shadows, emphasizing its texture and three-dimensionality.
title: Billet Head
